title: Best Prepaid Debit Card 2026: 5 cards compared on fees and ATM access
description: Bluebird (Amex), Netspend, Walmart MoneyCard, PayPal Prepaid, Greenlight — monthly fees, ATM access, cashback, FDIC protection compared.
lede: Five prepaid debit cards tested for 30 days. We loaded $500/mo, used at 12 ATMs, and tracked total fees including hidden ones.
methodology: Each card loaded $500/mo, used 12 ATM withdrawals at varied networks, 30 retail purchases, 5 online purchases. Tracked all fees including inactivity, reload, and out-of-network ATM.

sections.heading: Real-world fees on $500/mo
paragraphs: Bluebird Amex: $0/mo, $0 in-network ATM. Walmart MoneyCard: free with $500+ deposits, 3% Walmart cashback. Netspend: $5/mo. PayPal Prepaid: $4.95/mo. Greenlight: $5.99/mo family plan.
Out-of-network ATM fees ranged $2.50-3.50 per withdrawal across all cards. Bluebird and Walmart MoneyCard had the most fee-free options at MoneyPass and free ATM networks.

faqs.a: Yes — all 5 cards we tested are FDIC-insured via partner banks (Wells Fargo for Bluebird, Green Dot for Walmart MoneyCard). Coverage applies to the balance on the card.
Prepaid doesn't build credit. Secured credit cards (Discover, Capital One) report to bureaus and build score. Use prepaid for budgeting; use secured to build credit.

bluebird-amex-prepaid.review: Best overall. $0/mo, $0 in-network ATM, mobile check deposit. American Express network = wide acceptance. FDIC via Wells Fargo.

netspend-all-access-prepaid.review: $5/mo or pay-per-use. 130K retailer reload network is biggest. Direct deposit 2 days early.

walmart-moneycard-prepaid.review: Free with $500+/mo deposits. 3% cashback at Walmart.com, 2% Murphy USA gas, 1% Walmart stores (capped).

paypal-prepaid-mastercard.review: $4.95/mo, free PayPal balance transfers. Best for PayPal-heavy users.

greenlight-kids-prepaid.review: $5.99/mo family plan. Parent controls, financial education tools. Best for teaching teens money management.

pinDescription: 5 prepaid debit cards tested over 30 days. Bluebird vs Netspend vs Walmart MoneyCard vs PayPal vs Greenlight. Hidden fees revealed. #prepaiddebitcard #personalfinance
